title: helm: stabilize private values schema + init-hook upgrade/rollback compatibility
author: Asha Patel
description: This PR stabilizes the Helm chart values schema for redwood-private installs and improves init hook behavior to make upgrades and rollbacks more robust. Motivation: customers running Private in air-gapped and VPC environments hit schema validation and init job ordering issues during multi-stage upgrades. Changes include a strict OpenAPI-style values schema for top-level fields, optional migration hooks for CRD and secret rotations, templating fixes to preserve immutable fields during upgrades, toleration and nodeSelector propagation for init jobs, and a compatibility layer for older values (v1alpha -> v1beta). Includes migration guidance in chart CHANGELOG and docs/helm/private-upgrades.md. See Linear tasks ENG-1789 and ENG-1822 for context. Checklist: [x] values schema and CI validation [x] init hook ordering tests [x] upgrade/rollback smoke test [x] doc updates [x] chart linting.
